notes.title: (Promo) OKJOY's "Cavalry Girls" shooter game is now live!
notes.content:
Published by OKJOY, the light Rogue mech-girl top-down shooter "Cavalry Girls" is set to officially launch on the Steam platform at 01:00 Pacific Time today (October 20th)! The game has a total playtime of over 20 hours!

Store page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2055050/_/?utm_source=tonggao&utm_campaign=shoufa

[h3]Game Introduction:[/h3]
Cavalry Girls is a light roguelike top-down shooter indie game. In this game, players will lead Cavalry Girls into battles against enemy forces. Modify various mecha models, strategically deploy mechas with different skills, repel the overwhelming enemies, and defend your empire amid the raging fires. With limited supplies, players will have to make wise resource allocations, manage soldiers and survive on an increasingly intense battlefield.

[h3]Game Featured[/h3]
[b]
Top-Down Shooting[/b]

- Experience the authentic shooting feel and enjoy the thrilling battlefield.
- A plethora of equipment modules to choose from, with each weapon offering distinct effects.
- Engage in rogue-like combat against dozens of enemy types.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458630/da19247ff2bf6466bd226ca5d72d91175477b64a.gif[/img]
[b]
Strategic Deployment[/b]

- Choose your favorite equipment and teammates and pick modules to build the most powerful mecha.
- Gather intelligence for strategic deployment and strike enemies based on their unique characteristics.
- Make decisions using limited resources - take risks or play it safe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458630/82762e0d6f028ec0da94c5d734abab766a52bebb.gif[/img]

[b]Casual Gameplay[/b]

- Five recruitable characters with distinct personalities. Choose your favorite Cavalry Girls to accompany you in battle.
- Arrange cozy dorms for Cavalry Girls and give them gifts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38458630/a8e869f4ba3bf18ca467dff232593b444f7f7bc5.gif[/img]

notes.title: ‘The Book of Hiro’ Update Announcement 20230913
notes.content:
Dear players,

Ever since our game first made its debut, your sincere feedback and suggestions have been the cornerstone of our progress. We deeply appreciate your continued support and invaluable insights. Based on your feedback, we've made several optimizations and fixes to the game:



【Optimizations】

Reduced brightness when clues appear.

Fine-tuned the timing of hint appearances.

Revised the design for levels 1-7.


【Fixes】

Corrected the display issue of the menu background on certain screens.

Addressed a series of issues caused by system compatibility.

Disabled anti-aliasing to alleviate crashes due to memory leaks.

Fixed the animation issue when opening the treasure box in level 3.

Refactored resolution settings to resolve crash and blue screen issues.

We'd like to express our gratitude for your unwavering support. Every piece of advice and feedback from you is highly treasured, and we hope to continually hear from you.

notes.title: [Event]The 3D puzzle game ‘The Book of Hiro' officially launches today!
notes.content:
Developed by Mingzang Studio and published by OKJOY, the 3D optical illusion puzzle game 'The Book of Hiro' has officially launched on Steam today (September 8th) at 17:00 GMT+8.

[h2]Game Introduction:[/h2]
"The Book of Hiro" is a unique 3D optical illusion puzzle game developed by a team of two independent developers. The game unfolds within a magical book where each chapter boasts its own 3D map and distinct set of clues. Players are tasked with assisting Hiro on his adventure to the palace. By leveraging optical illusions and perspectives, navigate tumultuous rivers, search for the Sword of the Brave, and unravel a series of surreal puzzles. Discover and acquire the key to breakthrough and explore the enchanting world within this magical book.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44426843/62888bb62aa45a0b4dad512035f7feeb4d8fb48b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Steam Store Page：[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2533870/_/?utm_source=tonggao&utm_campaign=shoufa

[h2]Event Time:[/h2]
How to Participate: After purchasing the game, share a scene from 'The Book of Hiro' that you particularly enjoyed on the Steam community. Also, share your opinions and suggestions about the game, or talk about your favorite scenario or puzzle in the game!

[h3]---------------------How to Upload Screenshots---------------------[/h3]

After capturing the screenshot with your software, go to the Community Center - Artworks - Upload Artwork. After uploading, click on the bottom right "Upload to Community Center."

[h3]Event Duration:[/h3]
From now until 12:00 on September 21, 2023, GMT+8

[h3]Event Reward:[/h3]
Draw one participant to win a $5 Steam gift card.

[h3]Note:[/h3]
1. Each participant can only join the event once. Please avoid multiple posts and comments. No plagiarizing or reposting. Only original content is allowed.
2. The list of winners will be announced within 15 working days after the event concludes.
3. Official staff will distribute the prizes within 30 working days after the winner registration closes.
4. The final interpretation of this event belongs to the OKJOY team.

'The Book of Hiro' is a unique 3D optical illusion puzzle game. The game narrates the story of the brave villager Hiro who is on a mission to meet the king in the palace. Players will change directions, and use optical illusions and perspectives to piece together specified patterns to find the hidden "key" on the map and unravel the mysteries in space.

Thank you all for your support! If you have any feedback or suggestions for the game, you're welcome to join our group discussion!

notes.title: The Book of Hiro will launch on Steam on September 8th!
notes.content:
The 3D optical illusion puzzle game "The Book of Hiro" will launch on Steam on September 8th! Unlock the intriguing spatial visual puzzles.

Developed by Mingzang Studio and published by OKJOY, the 3D optical illusion puzzle game "The Book of Hiro" is set to officially release on the Steam platform at 02:00 on September 8th. The game supports multiple languages, including Simplified Chinese and English.

For this release version, we have fixed the bugs reported in the prologue demo and optimized the auto-correction function. The game content will showcase a complete story across 7 chapters, offering everyone a fresh and engaging visual puzzle-solving and narrative experience. 

[h2]Steam Store Page:[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2533870/_/

[h2]Game Introduction:[/h2]
"The Book of Hiro" is a unique 3D optical illusion puzzle game developed by a team of two independent developers. The game unfolds within a magical book where each chapter boasts its own 3D map and distinct set of clues. Players are tasked with assisting Hiro on his adventure to the palace. By leveraging optical illusions and perspectives, navigate tumultuous rivers, search for the Sword of the Brave, and unravel a series of surreal puzzles. Discover and acquire the key to breakthrough and explore the enchanting world within this magical book.

[h2]Play the Prologue Demo here: [/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2533740/_/

[h3][Innovative Visual Puzzles][/h3]
The game features innovative visual puzzles that are imaginative and visually stunning. The innovative visual illusion-finding gameplay involves moving the viewing angle, clicking, and other operations to find the hidden “key” pattern in the picture. Each puzzle solved can advance the plot and provide a unique gaming experience and visual impact.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44444375/e3c0db760d61bcd51d2f94c330a8f6e81e9f7813.gif[/img]

[h3][Vivid 3D Graphics][/h3]
The game features a simple and fresh 3D low-poly style that is full of childlike innocence while meticulously depicting the different scenes in the story. The game’s soothing and distant music complements the graphics to create a mysterious visual pop-up book.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44444375/40096b49350575ac79df0e78b5975668eae5490d.gif[/img]

[h3][Challenging Gameplay][/h3]
The game features shiny gold coins, ordinary keys, hammers, gears, and other objects that are common but difficult to find due to the game’s unusual mechanics. Players must make bold guesses and not be fooled by seemingly unrelated images. They must carefully observe and remember that what they see is not necessarily what they get!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44444375/5ac512823f8f8aa38a077f550270dbafb478812a.gif[/img]

[h3][Intriguing Storyline][/h3]
The game features an energetic and art-inspired storybook style. Behind the seemingly ordinary protagonist’s travel story is a hidden plot and an extraordinary experience. The game includes a main storyline and hidden endings waiting for you to explore.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44444375/b7b742608a715771bf0f8378b419989419c56b07.gif[/img]
